modules.name: Home and DS&A command view
policyBasis: BRD 6.1 (command view is a proposal [decide: scope])
modules.purpose: One home per role. The Data Administrator's home is the DS&A command view: per policy, open obligations, service levels due and overdue, KPIs; every other role sees only items assigned to it.
actions: filter by policy, sector, responsible party, status

modules.name: DS&A service requests
modules.purpose: The seven DS&A services (ANL data analysis, NGS NG survey, DDS DDA survey, DBC dashboard creation, DBA dashboard access, DBE dashboard enhancement, and data gap submission) with acknowledgment, approvals and the redirect of extracts and corrections.
screens: New request (service picker, redirect message, acknowledgment)

modules.name: External data sharing
modules.purpose: Every external request from receipt to release, on the 15-working-day clock, with the five Director General triggers and the Data Sharing Register.
screens: Sharing detail (trigger check, owner confirmation, decision, Access Permission terms, release)

modules.name: Data quality issues and corrections
modules.purpose: One issue log; routing by root cause; standard-correction instructions DS&A may trigger only under a pre-approved rule; business-judgment changes; fit for use and closure; data incidents.
screens: Issue detail (route, instruction, objection, fix due by fix type, fit for use, re-measure)

modules.name: Institution remediation
modules.purpose: Issue lists by institution; owner acknowledgment and notification; correction and backfill clocks; fit for use; referral of overdue items. DS&A never chases institutions.
screens: Producer worklist with bulk status update

modules.name: Access management
modules.purpose: Access requests, project access for PRP and QAC, the access register, six-monthly recertification, revocation, service provider access and DS&A standing access.

modules.name: Change and field requests
modules.purpose: The joint field process (Service Design, DS&A, owner, Digital Excellence) and system changes with a data impact assessment and go-live checklist.
screens: Field change board (one column per step)

modules.name: Registers
modules.purpose: The twelve BRD registers plus the POC additions (manual collections, timeliness commitments, model register, statistical publications), each with version history and review cycle.

modules.name: Policy tracker and acknowledgments
modules.purpose: The 14 governing documents, each with its obligations, service levels, KPIs (and supporting measures for the three merged policies), status and link to the published document; the three documents retired on 15 October 2026 in a short note; acknowledgments of new versions.
screens: Policy detail (obligations, service levels, KPIs, open items, link)

modules.name: Service levels and escalation
modules.purpose: Working-day clocks, reminders, automatic escalation (CDO, then the Group, then the Director General after 15 working days), Governance section flags.
screens: Service level board (due soon, overdue by responsible party)

modules.name: Monitoring and KPIs
modules.purpose: The 28 KPIs by lifecycle stage (supporting measures shown on their policy, not here), the Governance section workspace and the draft monthly compliance report.

modules.name: Audit log
modules.purpose: Every create, view, change, approval, export and delete, with user, role, time and before and after values. Read-only.
